purpose: Fast bounded screen of three previously untested, reconstructible continuation families selected for native XAUUSD event supply and causal completed-bar timing. No post-result rescue tuning.

execution.signal_surface: native Dukascopy bars/tick volume as specified per lane

rules.long: completed AO crosses below->above zero; completed close above both Senkou spans; SpanA < SpanB per source code
rules.short: completed AO crosses above->below zero; completed close below both Senkou spans; SpanA > SpanB per source code
rules.entry: first executable tick at/after signal-bar right edge

rules.trend: EMA13 above EMA50 for long, below for short
rules.pullback: long: completed bar closes below EMA13 but low and close stay above EMA50; short mirror
rules.reclaim: next or later completed bar closes back across EMA13 while trend stack still valid
rules.volume: OBV above its EMA20 for long; below EMA20 for short
rules.session: 09:30-11:00 America/New_York, weekdays; source avoids Mondays, so Monday excluded
rules.entry: first executable tick at/after reclaim-bar right edge

rules.direction: both bull and bear source mirror
rules.signal: completed close beyond confirmed box boundary with breakout tick volume >= 1.3x running box-period average
rules.entry: first executable tick at/after breakout-bar right edge
rules.note: Screen source state-machine entry grammar only; source staircase exits/risk are not imported.

gate.survivor_action: advance only source-default survivors to independent later-January validation

prohibited: side/session rescue except source-specified session in 17CF
